signals.title: AUD/USD — G10 Bilateral Theme + Geopolitical Shock
signals.text: AUD COT LF long +55.7k (74.5% long, 95th percentile) creates severe crowded-long liquidation risk as AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.7026 testing its 200-day SMA at 0.7026. Heightened Middle East escalation over Iranian actions in the Strait of Hormuz accelerates broad safe-haven dollar accumulation against high-beta commodity currencies, reinforcing the 1.711% G10 divergence spread against AUD. The RBA Interest Rate Decision on 29 Sep determines whether domestic policy support can halt the unwind. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD into the Sydney open; crowded spec positioning leaves spot vulnerable to break below 0.7026. Catalyst: Sydney open and RBA Interest Rate Decision on 29 Sep. Risk: A hawkish RBA rate hike surprise or sudden de-escalation in Middle East tensions invalidates the bearish bias.

signals.title: USD/CAD — COT Short Squeeze + Bear Steepener
signals.text: CAD COT LF short -49.1k (28.1% long) maintains significant short-covering risk as USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.4141, trading firmly above its 200-day SMA at 1.3841. The widening US-Canada 10-year yield spread (-124bp) and an ongoing US bear steepener (+31.4bp 2s10s) fuel USD demand via a +158bp OIS carry advantage (SOFR 3.88% vs CORRA 2.30%). Canada GDP data on 29 Sep and the next BoC meeting (mkt: 64% hike priced) on 28 Oct serve as the key fundamental catalysts. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CAD; structural carry and short CAD positioning support upward continuation above 1.4140. Catalyst: Canada GDP m/m on 29 Sep at 12:30 UTC. Risk: A drop back below 1.4000 or an unexpected surge in Canadian growth invalidates the upward momentum.

signals.title: USD/JPY — Options Downside Skew vs Carry Gap
signals.text: Options markets show an extreme put skew in USD/JPY with 25-delta risk reversals at -2.28 while spot closed Friday at 157.19. Geopolitical tensions in the Persian Gulf drive safe-haven demand into JPY despite a prohibitive +290bp OIS carry penalty favoring USD (SOFR 3.88% vs TONA 0.98%). BoJ Monetary Policy Meeting Minutes at 23:50 UTC provide the initial directional test ahead of the next BoJ meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 30 Oct. Trade bias: Bearish USD/JPY on headline safe-haven flows; elevated options put demand points toward a test of the 20-day SMA at 156.40. Catalyst: BoJ Meeting Minutes release at 23:50 UTC. Risk: Sustained carry re-engagement above 158.00 invalidates the short bias.

signals.title: USD/CHF — Negative Real Rate Divergence
signals.text: CHF COT LF short stands at -18.6k (24.8% long, 7th percentile) as USD/CHF closed Friday at 0.8283 above its 20-day SMA at 0.8168. Swiss National Bank comments affirming interest rate stability reinforce the 400bp CB rate differential (Fed 4.00% vs SNB 0.00%) and a deeply negative Swiss real rate of -1.24%. Switzerland KOF Economic Barometer on 29 Sep and the next SNB meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 10 Dec determine the durability of franc weakness. Trade bias: Bullish USD/CHF; massive nominal carry advantage and negative Swiss real rates keep the pair supported above 0.8250. Catalyst: Switzerland KOF Economic Barometer on 29 Sep at 07:00 UTC. Risk: Escalating geopolitical risk-off driving defensive CHF repatriation below 0.8200 invalidates the setup.
